title: Why Crypto Is So Volatile
summary: Volatility measures how much and how quickly a price swings. Crypto is known for high volatility: double-digit daily moves are not unusual.
blocks: Volatility measures how much and how quickly a price swings. Crypto is known for high volatility: double-digit daily moves are not unusual.
Several things feed it — round-the-clock global trading, markets that are still young and comparatively small, heavy reliance on sentiment and news, and thin liquidity in smaller coins.
Volatility cuts both ways and is a feature of the asset class, not a malfunction. Knowing that a quoted price can change fast is the first step to reading these markets calmly.
